items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There were, we had Wardell Gray, we had Gene Ammons, we had Yusef Lateef, all these guys

ctx.x: Coleman Hawkins. Graves:…did he ever say ilk…

Yeah, Coleman Hawkins. Well, well, no, no, Dexter might be a little in between. Here’s Coleman Hawkins, Ben Webster and…other people. They’re sort of here, Dexter might have been a little notch on his own the way he played. There were, we had Wardell Gray, we had Gene Ammons, we had Yusef Lateef, all these guys, these cats, they played
